questions.question: The quarterly report has been delayed ______ the server outage.
questions.explanation: due to 表原因，后接名词短语，表示“由于”之意。

questions.question: All employees must submit their expense reports ______ Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: by 表示“不迟于”，截止时间用 by。

questions.question: The new software ______ improve team collaboration significantly.
questions.explanation: be expected to 固定搭配，表示“预期将”。

questions.question: Neither the manager nor the assistants ______ available for the meeting.
questions.explanation: neither...nor 就近原则，助词 assistants 复数，用 are。

questions.question: The contract ______ by both parties before the deadline.
questions.explanation: contract 是被签署，需被动语态 must be signed。

questions.question: Please ______ the attached document before the presentation.
questions.explanation: 祈使句用动词原形 review。

questions.question: The marketing team has ______ the new campaign strategy.
questions.explanation: has + 过去分词构成现在完成时，用 finalized。

questions.question: ______ the budget was tight, the project was completed on time.
questions.explanation: Although 表让步，“尽管预算紧张，项目仍按时完成”。

questions.question: The client requested that the proposal ______ by next Monday.
questions.explanation: request that 从句用虚拟语气 be + 过去分词。

questions.question: Our new supplier offers ______ competitive pricing than the previous one.
questions.explanation: 比较级 more competitive pricing 表示“更具竞争力的定价”。

questions.question: The CEO ______ the annual report when the power went out.
questions.explanation: when 引导时间状语，主句用过去进行时 was reviewing。

questions.question: The training session is mandatory ______ all new hires.
questions.explanation: mandatory for sb. 固定搭配，“对……是强制性的”。

questions.question: ______ the new policy takes effect next month, employees should prepare now.
questions.explanation: As 此处作“随着、随同”，表示伴随情况。

questions.question: The team ______ the project ahead of schedule last quarter.
questions.explanation: last quarter 过去时间标志，用一般过去时 completed。

questions.question: We appreciate ______ feedback on the new product design.
questions.explanation: appreciate 后接名词/动名词，your feedback 作宾语。

questions.question: The warehouse will be closed ______ inventory counting next week.
questions.explanation: for 表目的，“为了盘点库存”。

questions.question: If the shipment ______ late, we will contact the carrier immediately.
questions.explanation: if 条件状语从句用一般现在时代将来，arrives。

questions.question: The director suggested ______ the meeting until Thursday.
questions.explanation: suggest doing 固定搭配，建议“延期”。

questions.question: Each of the department heads ______ responsible for the budget review.
questions.explanation: Each of + 复数名词，谓语用单数 is。

questions.question: The report ______ by the analyst before the board meeting.
questions.explanation: report 是被完成，将来时被动 will be finished。

questions.question: Not only did the sales increase, ______ customer satisfaction improved.
questions.explanation: Not only...but also 固定倒装结构，but also 引导后半句。

questions.question: The new intern ______ the files alphabetically yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 过去时间，一般过去时 organized。

questions.question: We need to ______ the budget before the fiscal year ends.
questions.explanation: need to 不定式结构，动词原形 finalize。

questions.question: The conference room ______ for the client presentation at 2 PM.
questions.explanation: room 是被预订，一般现在时被动 is reserved。

questions.question: ______ the project manager approves the plan, we can start next week.
questions.explanation: Once 表“一旦……就”，引导时间状语从句。

questions.question: The company has decided to ______ its overseas operations.
questions.explanation: decide to do 固定搭配，动词原形 expand。

questions.question: No sooner ______ the email than the phone rang.
questions.explanation: No sooner...than 倒装，had I sent 过去完成时倒装。

questions.question: The financial audit ______ completed by the end of this month.
questions.explanation: 将来完成时被动 will have been completed，“将已完成”。

questions.question: Please ensure that all data ______ accurately in the system.
questions.explanation: ensure that 从句用被动 is entered，data 是被录入。

questions.question: The new regulations require all vendors ______ compliance certificates.
questions.explanation: require sb. to do 固定搭配，require all vendors to provide。

questions.question: ______ the heavy traffic, the delivery arrived on schedule.
questions.explanation: Despite 表让步，“尽管交通拥堵，送货仍准时到达”。

questions.question: The software update ______ installed automatically overnight.
questions.explanation: update 是被安装，将来时被动 will be installed，省略过去分词。

questions.question: The manager asked ______ the report would be ready by Friday.
questions.explanation: asked if 引导宾语从句，询问“是否”。

questions.question: All staff members are required ______ the safety training seminar.
questions.explanation: be required to do 固定搭配，“被要求做某事”。

questions.question: The quarterly results were ______ better than expected.
questions.explanation: 修饰比较级 better 用副词 considerably。

questions.question: The supplier ______ we contacted last week has agreed to the terms.
questions.explanation: 先行词 supplier 为物，作宾语，用 which（可省略）。

questions.question: The team leader recommended that the project ______ reviewed immediately.
questions.explanation: recommend that 虚拟语气，be + 过去分词 reviewed。

questions.question: By the time the audit starts, all records ______ organized.
questions.explanation: By the time...将来完成时被动 will have been organized。

questions.question: The new hire demonstrated ______ leadership skills during the crisis.
questions.explanation: demonstrated 后接名词作宾语，用形容词 exceptional 修饰 skills。
